name: riftseer
_workspacesExcluded: packages/reddit-bot (Devvit/npm standalone) and packages/raycast-extension (Raycast/npm standalone) are intentionally excluded — both require npm and are not Bun workspace members.

scripts.dev: bun run --filter '@riftseer/api' dev & bun run --filter '@riftseer/web' dev & wait
scripts.typecheck: ./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p packages/types/tsconfig.json && ./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && ./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p packages/api/tsconfig.json && ./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p packages/api/tsconfig.test.json && ./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p packages/ingest-worker/tsconfig.json && ./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p packages/ingest-worker/tsconfig.test.json
